description: A PHP class defining a Markdown content type for HTML file content within a documentation or content rendering tool. It extends another content type class and creates a converter object with specific configuration.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: Extends the base Markdown content type to use a specific Markdown converter configured with the 'daux' options.

methods.name: createConverter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of CommonMarkConverter with the 'daux' configuration options.
